glossary.sigma: Sigma — Open standard format for threat detection rules, independent of SIEM systems.
glossary.mitre: MITRE ATT&CK — Reference framework describing attack tactics and techniques used by adversaries.
glossary.fim: FIM — File Integrity Monitoring. Detects unauthorized modifications to sensitive files.
glossary.ebpf: eBPF — Extended Berkeley Packet Filter. Kernel technology for real-time monitoring of system calls.
glossary.journald: Journald — Systemd journal service that collects system and application logs.
glossary.hmac: HMAC — Hash-based Message Authentication Code. Mechanism for verifying message integrity and authenticity.
glossary.clickhouse: ClickHouse — High-performance columnar analytical database for storing and analyzing events.
glossary.correlation: Correlation — Automated analysis linking multiple events to detect complex threats.

hunting.title: Threat Hunting
hunting.templatesDescription: Pre-configured hunting queries to get started quickly.
hunting.templateNonEuConnectionsQuery: event = 'connect' AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '10.%' AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '192.168.%'
hunting.templateConfigChangesQuery: event IN ('fim','fim_v4_8','FIM write') AND filename LIKE '/etc/%'
hunting.templateSecurityDisableQuery: message LIKE '%systemctl stop%' OR message LIKE '%iptables -F%' OR message LIKE '%auditctl -e 0%'
